rationale: Every label is a cluster of 8px-tall stroked paths, so the figure has no <text> element at all: min_font, contrast, overflow and word-count checks all pass vacuously and the score is 10 while the labels are unreadable at teaching size. A block with no <text> child, or a path cluster of many tiny segments inside a block, should be reported as an outlined (non-addressable) label.
folded: implemented as a measurable check; kind changed from gaming to defect
